before: Home on a wrapped line skipped its first character, End stopped before trailing spaces or at a visual edge, and a caret placed at a wrap showed at the end of the upper line.
after: Home and End use logical line edges. A caret placed at a wrap shows at the start of the next line, and End or a click past the line end keeps the upper line as local affinity.
reason: Line affinity stays local to each editor. It adds no shared field or document operation, and remote edits keep it.
